copy.tagline: 用行为驱动方式编写测试用例
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果习惯先写行为再写代码
copy.tagline_en: Write test cases with behavior-driven approach
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer writing behaviors before code

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude 将扮演开发者角色，专注于编写或改进测试。它从用户可见的行为出发，而非实现细节，确保测试名称描述可观察行为，避免将已知缺陷编码为正确行为。若发现产品缺陷，会明确指出。
howto.when: 当您要求编写或改进测试时，Claude 会自动切换至开发者角色并执行行为优先的测试指导。您也可以通过 `/test` 指令直接触发。

say.text: 为这个登录功能编写测试
say.note: Claude 会从用户行为出发设计测试用例。

say.text: 检查现有测试是否符合行为优先原则
say.note: Claude 会审查测试命名和断言内容。

say.text: 改进这个测试，确保它覆盖用户可见行为
say.note: Claude 会调整测试使其聚焦可观察结果。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude adopts a Developer persona focused on writing or improving tests. It starts from expected user behavior, not implementation details. Test names describe observable behavior. Claude never asserts known bugs as correct and explicitly calls out product bugs.
howto.when_en: This skill activates when you ask to write or improve tests, or when you invoke `/test`. Claude switches to Developer persona and follows behavior-first test guidance.

say_en.text: Write tests for this login feature.
say_en.note: Claude will design test cases from user behavior.

say_en.text: Review if existing tests follow behavior-first principles.
say_en.note: Claude will examine test naming and assertions.

say_en.text: Improve this test to cover user-visible behavior.
say_en.note: Claude will adjust tests to focus on observable outcomes.
